items.kind: duplicated logic (with a 'keep in sync' comment)
items.observation: The cache key is built by hand in two places. Committed tool/eval_cache file names depend on this format.
items.proposed_fix: A single private `cacheKey(label, prompt)` function (in response_cache.dart); both sites should use it. test/cache_test.dart:97 and 323 already pin the format.
items.closure_criteria: A single private cacheKey function in response_cache.dart builds the key and both call sites use it. test/cache_test.dart passes and still pins the format at its cases 97 and 323.

items.observation: BaselineCase, EvalBaseline, CaseChange and EvalDiff were added in 1.1.0 (5baa49d, 2026-08-09) as plain `class`. Yet 6d049df (2026-07-24) had sealed the value types. A consumer can extend or implement these classes. Collections are also stored without copying.
items.proposed_fix: In 2.0: `final class`, unmodifiable copies, and freeze tests. Keep it on the record until then.
items.closure_criteria: In 2.0 the four baseline classes are final class and copy caller collections into unmodifiable ones. Freeze tests pin the copies.

items.observation: toJson writes `'version': 1` but fromJson never reads this field. A future format would be silently misread.
items.proposed_fix: Make fromJson validate the version (1 if the field is missing, FormatException on an unknown version) and add a test.
items.closure_criteria: fromJson treats a missing version field as 1 and throws FormatException on an unknown version. A test covers both paths.

items.observation: EvalBaseline.fromReport is built not from the typed report but by re-parsing the `report.toJson()` output with casts.
items.proposed_fix: Build fromReport through CaseResult/AttemptResult/CheckOutcome. Keep fromReportJson for file reading. Safety net: baseline_test.dart.
items.closure_criteria: EvalBaseline.fromReport builds from CaseResult, AttemptResult and CheckOutcome values without re-parsing report.toJson. baseline_test.dart passes and fromReportJson still reads files.

items.observation: `static int _tempCounter` is process-wide mutable state. Why it is static (a unique temporary name across instances sharing the same directory) is written nowhere.
items.proposed_fix: Write the rationale in the dartdoc or use a unique suffix that needs no shared state.
items.closure_criteria: The static counter carries a dartdoc rationale or the temporary file names use a suffix that needs no shared state.

items.observation: The e2e tag is defined with a 3 minute timeout but no test carries this tag. The e2e test runs with the default 30 s, and `--exclude-tags e2e` does not exclude it.
items.proposed_fix: Add `@Tags(['e2e'])` and `library;` to the test (as in instructor_dart).
items.closure_criteria: test/ollama_e2e_test.dart starts with library; and carries @Tags(['e2e']). Running dart test --exclude-tags e2e skips it.

items.observation: Three formatters are embedded in the EvalReport value model: JSON (143-180), JUnit XML (203-327), Markdown (335-407). Every new format changes the model class.
items.proposed_fix: Move JUnit and Markdown generation to private lib/src files and let the existing methods call them. The public API stays unchanged. Safety net: report_test.dart and junit_xml_test.dart.
items.closure_criteria: JUnit XML and Markdown generation live in private lib/src files and the EvalReport methods call them. report_test.dart and junit_xml_test.dart pass.

items.observation: The quote of the judge response is cut at 200 characters. The constant has neither a name nor a rationale.
items.proposed_fix: A named const and a one-sentence rationale.
items.closure_criteria: The quote limit is a named const with a one-sentence rationale at its definition.

items.observation: The catches at the user-code boundary catch everything by contract. But the `catch (e)` spelling trips the shared typed catch rule (J10, D11) and the intent is not readable from the code.
items.proposed_fix: `on Object catch` with a one-line rationale. Name the exception in the EVAL-03 rule.
items.closure_criteria: All listed catch sites read on Object catch with a one-line rationale comment. The EVAL-03 rule text names the exception.

items.observation: The dartdoc says 'Deduplication is planned for a later release'. The Planned list in the README (README.md:399-408) does not include it, and there is no issue link.
items.proposed_fix: The dartdoc should describe only current behavior. Move the plan to the README Planned section or to an issue.
items.closure_criteria: The eval_suite.dart dartdoc describes only current behavior. The deduplication plan appears in the README Planned section or a tracked issue.

items.observation: The core claims to run on every platform (including web), but CI runs only on the VM.
items.proposed_fix: Add `dart test -p chrome` to CI. Put `@TestOn('vm')` on the tests that use dart:io (cache_test, ollama_e2e_test).
items.closure_criteria: ci.yaml runs dart test -p chrome and the run passes. The tests that use dart:io carry @TestOn('vm').
